FEES

You know the cost before we start

Fees are agreed in writing according to the nature and complexity of each matter, always in line with the Greek Lawyers' Code.

Three ways to agree the fee

  • Fixed fee

    For defined tasks, such as a contract, a title check or an uncontested divorce.

  • Per stage

    For court cases: we agree the fee for each stage separately.

  • Hourly or retainer

    For businesses that need ongoing legal support.

What affects the fee

  • How complex the matter is and how many documents we need to review
  • Whether court proceedings are needed, and in which court
  • How urgent the matter is
  • Whether work in English or translations are required

What the written proposal includes

  • The work we will carry out
  • The fee and when it is paid
  • Costs that are not fees, such as court charges, stamp duties and bailiffs' fees
  • An indicative timeline

Frequently asked questions

How much does the first meeting cost?

We tell you the cost of the first meeting when we book it, so there are no surprises.

Does the fee include VAT?

In the written proposal the fee is shown before VAT, with VAT listed separately, so you know the exact final amount.

Can I pay in instalments?

For larger matters we can agree to payment in parts, usually per stage of the case.

Would you like to discuss your matter?

Tell us briefly what it's about. We reply within one working day.
